Subject: Final MAP update + loadtest results (summary)

Carlos / OptiSearch team — thanks for reviewing the runs. Below is the condensed results summary and recommended next steps. Full artifacts are attached and on the shared drive (link above).

Summary of key metrics (P95 unless noted):
- Reranker (single-request, no batching): P50 95ms / P95 180ms.
- Reranker (continuous batching, max_batch_size=32): throughput 820 reqs/sec, P50 105ms, P95 235ms.
- Reranker (max_batch_size=64): throughput 980 reqs/sec, but P95 rose to 360ms due to queuing on the batching window.
- Embeddings (fp16 host): median latency per embed 38ms, sustained throughput 13.2k/hr on the dedicated pool.
- TTFT (end-to-end for chat->rerank path): P50 210ms, P95 285ms (meets target).
- Error rate: <0.08% 5xx across runs.

Interpretation and recommendations:
1) With continuous batching capped at 32 we hit OptiSearch's P95 latency target (235ms vs target 250ms) while achieving near-target throughput. Increasing batch size to 64 gives higher throughput but violates P95 latency SLO. Recommendation: operate at max_batch_size=32 in production, enable adaptive batching (auto-decrease batch on latency regressions).

2) Embedding pipeline comfortably meets latency and throughput targets on a 1x dedicated pool; for peak hours suggest burst-capacity or autoscale to 1.5x.

3) Ops playbook (quick):
   - If P95 > 10% above target: reduce max_batch_size to 16, switch to smaller reranker variant (openbert-medium-quant), and enable immediate cache warming for top queries.
   - If throughput dips: scale dedicated GPU pool by +25% and enable cross-region fallback to our eu-us pool.

Action & close timeline:
- OptiSearch to confirm production config (batch=32, q4 reranker) by Jun 18.
- We will prepare the PO + 30-day reserved run quote; Marissa will attach final commercial terms.
- DocuSign link above will be sent after confirmation; planned go-live (pilot) Jun 28.
